title: Symbiosis V7 Web UI Screen Atlas

platform.delivery: desktop-first local web application served over HTTP by a bundled local server; file:// is unsupported
platform.sharedState: The host local server is authoritative for campaign, battle, clock, seats and shared runtime state; browser clients are projections.
platform.transport: HTTP for shell/assets/snapshots and WebSocket for revisions, prompts, handoffs and reconnect-aware events.
platform.storage: Local durable data with explicit schema/baseline version, checksum, migration gate, checkpoints and immutable campaign archive.
platform.soundtrack: Soundtrack files are supplied outside this work; Track_ID routing, synchronization, local volume and silent fallback remain mandatory.

sourcePriority: 1. Direct requirements of the atlas prompt and later author decisions, only where they do not contradict senior baseline artifacts.
2. Delivery Manifest v1.2 for line composition, compatibility and frozen-artifact boundaries.
3. The relevant senior domain registry: Executable Rules, Character/Skills/Symbionts, Items, Effects/Diseases, Bestiary or Default Sentient Enemy Registry.
4. The relevant implementation specification: Soundtrack Registry for music and this cleaned atlas for UI.
5. All Questions and Answers Registry only when the decision is not already materialized in a senior registry.
6. Frozen runtime pack only for exact system templates and art, never for new rules.
7. Cross-Registry Audit as consistency evidence, not an independent mechanics source.
8. Symbiosis_V7_print_final only as a lower-priority narrative/visual aid; it cannot override any development artifact or revive excluded automation.

availableActions.negativeSpace: Forbidden or unavailable player/effective-controller commands, targets and parameter values do not exist in the network projection, DOM, accessibility tree, hotkeys or client cache. Read-only catalogs remain separate.
availableActions.invalidation: Recalculate after every confirmed resource, HP, OE, effect, position, visibility, inventory, equipment, ammo, cooldown, turn, phase, controller, consent, predicate, clock or campaign-state change.
availableActions.commitBoundary: Immediately before the first state write, recompute guards using the signed action envelope. Reject stale/direct-invalid requests before any reserve, roll, dose, XP, item or action spend.
availableActions.exceptionBanners: Rule banners are only a race-condition/direct-request safety net and explain the human rule without internal codes; they are not the normal menu filter.

authorityPrivacy.master: Exactly one active master authority; the GM tab exists only on the host computer.
authorityPrivacy.ordinaryDevice: Exactly 0–3 admitted local player seats and never a GM tab or GM projection.
authorityPrivacy.hostDevice: GM context plus 0–3 admitted local player seats; local-player bootstrap is provisional until normal admission completes.
authorityPrivacy.handoff: Every in-session player↔player, player↔GM and forced local-owner switch uses PLY-030; prior projection is erased before target acknowledgement. The sole exception is APP-002/APP-011→APP-001 at a launch shell with no active campaign/host/player projection, no pending command or authority handoff, after the entire prior role DOM/a11y/hotkey/cache namespace is disposed.

atomicityReconnect.commandIds: Mutation commands and one-shot generators use stable IDs. Same ID/same payload returns the previous receipt; same ID/different payload rejects.
atomicityReconnect.randomness: Random seed/result and roll mode snapshot are persisted before dependent resolution and never regenerated on reconnect.
atomicityReconnect.offline: No shared mutation is accepted offline. Reconnect restores server-confirmed seat, observer projection, initiative, timers and pending context.

accessibility.standard: WCAG AA contrast, keyboard completion, logical focus, screen-reader announcements and no information encoded by color alone.
accessibility.reducedMotion: All animations have a static/opacity alternative that preserves result visibility and mandatory timing without flashing or camera motion.

directAuthorDecisions2026-08-01.guardianTargetVisibility: For the exact selected eligible capture body, the Guardian player sees every resident symbiont's species name, level and current OE; Q-SYM-092's former hidden/random-victim branch is superseded.
directAuthorDecisions2026-08-01.plagueDoctorMonitor: For each infection of this Doctor: seven characteristics, known identity, alive, available, offMap and currentHP; no coordinates or unrelated hidden data.
directAuthorDecisions2026-08-01.chimeraCompletionOwnership: App-run completed Devouring is recorded automatically and atomically; GM confirms only external or earlier events with deduplication.
directAuthorDecisions2026-08-01.peaceWorldMap: PLY-001 → MAP-005 and MAP-006/MAP-007 already provide the player's observer-safe own location or explicit unknown state; this contour is retained unchanged.
directAuthorDecisions2026-08-01.conditionalScreens: PLY-033, PLY-034 and PLY-035 exist in a player projection only while the corresponding campaign-bound KEEPER, CHIMERA or PLAGUE_DOCTOR ownership guard is true.

rules.requirement: The master's computer owns the active logical track, playback position, start timestamp, active pool and shuffle-bag state. Clients reproduce this state.
BATTLE > NIGHT AMBIENT > DAY AMBIENT. Menu music applies only on pre-campaign menu flows.
Any active battle globally enables battle music. If several battles exist, use the battle involving the largest eligible group; ties use the older group.
Outside battle, use the location of the eligible group with the greatest headcount. Ties use immutable creationSequence ascending.
Count living active player characters and allied NPCs explicitly included in the group. Exclude enemies, dead characters and removed/inactive members.
City/garrison circle > No-Man's coastal overlay > No-Man's polygon > faction territory > Sea. Nэйт is always a Pure city override.
Night is [21:00, 06:00). Day is [06:00, 21:00). Use campaign game time/dayPhase; master-set localLighting never changes the music phase.
Switch immediately with a 2,000 ms crossfade when battle, dayPhase, determining group or spatial context changes. At exactly 21:00 outside battle, resolve the night pool.
Do not interrupt the current track when the effective pool remains unchanged, except for a required settlement/location entry opener.
On every new entry, marker placement or focus activation in a settlement, apply its entry rule. Movement within the same settlement does not restart music; exit and re-entry does.
Chado, Urahanta and Sadena choose randomly among their two local entry tracks. No separate Arena/Centre/Swamp sublocation field exists.
After an opener ends, use the location's continuation pool. Named city tracks may then appear in other cities of the same faction.
Play every eligible track once before refilling the bag. Do not select the just-finished track when another option exists.
If an opener also belongs to the continuation pool, mark it as consumed in the current bag to prevent immediate repetition.
If the determining battle includes at least one Pure participant, choose the first track from POOL_COMBAT_PURE_OPENERS, then use POOL_COMBAT_PURE_CONTINUATION.
On battle end, re-evaluate group, phase and zone. Resume a random eligible ambient track; do not replay a city opener unless a new entry/focus activation occurred.
On entering the Sea of Solitude at night, or when night begins at sea, play MUS-047 first, then POOL_SEA_NIGHT_CONTINUATION.
On daytime entry to NML_COASTAL, play MUS-048 first, then POOL_NML_DAY. Other No-Man's names do not imply extra map subzones.
All three red border garrisons are Free settlements and use the corresponding north/south Free city pools.
Outside Pure cities at night, use POOL_PURE_OUTSIDE_NIGHT, which reuses all Pure city-night tracks.
MUS-009 and MUS-041 have identical bytes. Keep two logical uses: menu and daytime Pure territory outside cities. Runtime asset deduplication is allowed.
If a campaign has no eligible group and no battle, fade to silence. Do not invent a map location.
Persist active track, offset, pool, remaining shuffle bag and RNG state in the campaign save. Resume without reselecting on load.
A disconnected client continues the last known track locally. On reconnect it accepts the master's state and resynchronizes with a crossfade/seek.
If a file is missing or fails the size/CRC integrity check, log the Track_ID and select the next eligible item. Never cross into another context pool.

events.requiredAction: Activate POOL_MENU; preserve current menu track across menu screens.
Resolve determining group, phase and zone; apply focus activation entry rules.
Re-resolve context. Settlement/location entry opener may force a switch.
Use largest headcount; tie uses earlier creationSequence.
Immediately activate determining battle music; night is ignored.
Re-evaluate current ambient context; no automatic city-entry replay.
Activate night context; only night-eligible tracks.
Activate day context; only day-eligible tracks.
Take next item from effective shuffle bag.
Apply master track/offset/pool state; preserve local mute/volume.

pools.initialRule: Local entry rule; otherwise pool random
Local entry rule; random pool for cities without a named track
Ainzbern local entry; otherwise pool random
Used after the night entry track

selectionSnapshot.determiningBattle: Largest eligible involved group headcount; ties use the older group.
selectionSnapshot.determiningGroup: Largest eligible headcount; ties use immutable creationSequence ascending.
selectionSnapshot.eligibleHeadcount: Living active PCs plus allied NPCs explicitly included; exclude enemies, dead and removed/inactive members.
selectionSnapshot.samePoolAndOpener: Keep the current track when the pool is unchanged, except a required new-entry opener; consume an opener also present in its continuation bag.
selectionSnapshot.persistence: Persist active Track_ID, offset, pool, remaining shuffle bag and RNG state; reconnect resumes the host state without reselecting.

diagrams.title: Длительный отдых
diagrams.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> REQUESTED
    REQUESTED --> PLANNED: GM participants and watches
    REQUESTED --> DECLINED: GM reason
    PLANNED --> RUNNING: start
    RUNNING --> INTERRUPTED: event or combat
    INTERRUPTED --> RUNNING: GM resume and restart segments
    INTERRUPTED --> CANCELLED: GM cancel
    RUNNING --> COMPLETE: accumulated 240 minutes

diagrams.title: Полный lifecycle боя и актора
diagrams.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> DRAFT
    DRAFT --> PREFLIGHT: sides, actors, positions, visibility
    PREFLIGHT --> ACTIVE: Start and freeze world time
    ACTIVE --> AMBUSH: optional preinitiative scene
    ACTIVE --> INITIATIVE: no ambush
    AMBUSH --> INITIATIVE: scene resolved
    INITIATIVE --> TURN: fixed strip built
    TURN --> COMMAND: available action declared
    COMMAND --> ROLL: request or accelerated same-command packet
    ROLL --> RESOLVE: roll chain complete
    RESOLVE --> TURN: next actor
    TURN --> FINISH: GM result
    FINISH --> LOOT: eligible player victory
    FINISH --> DISPOSITION: no loot
    LOOT --> DISPOSITION
    DISPOSITION --> CLOSED

diagrams.title: Потеря связи и reconnect
diagrams.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> CONNECTED
    CONNECTED --> LOST: heartbeat timeout
    LOST --> RECONNECTING: network available
    RECONNECTING --> RECONCILING: identity accepted
    RECONCILING --> CONFLICT: local command differs
    RECONCILING --> RESTORED: server snapshot and receipt
    CONFLICT --> RESTORED: server state accepted
    RESTORED --> CONNECTED

diagrams.title: Authoritative availableActions
diagrams.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> CALCULATE
    CALCULATE --> EMPTY: no executable command
    CALCULATE --> PROJECTED: allowed actions only
    PROJECTED --> REQUEST: consent or master predicate
    PROJECTED --> REVALIDATE: direct executable intent
    REQUEST --> CALCULATE: denied or state changed
    REQUEST --> REVALIDATE: positive linked response
    REVALIDATE --> STALE: revision or guard changed
    REVALIDATE --> COMMITTED: atomic write
    STALE --> CALCULATE
    COMMITTED --> CALCULATE

diagrams.title: Хранитель: выход, захват, перезапись и Попутчики
diagrams.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> OWNER_DEAD
    OWNER_DEAD --> OUTSIDE_BODY: confirmed exit
    OUTSIDE_BODY --> CAPTURE: eligible body and chosen symbiont
    CAPTURE --> OUTSIDE_BODY: equal OE, expelled
    CAPTURE --> TERMINAL: lower OE
    CAPTURE --> PRE_REWRITE: greater OE
    PRE_REWRITE --> REWRITING: first 4h sleep
    REWRITING --> COMPANIONS: United host
    COMPANIONS --> PAUSED: stop or equal OE
    PAUSED --> COMPANIONS: resume after OE recovery
    COMPANIONS --> FINAL: explicit final configuration
    REWRITING --> FINAL: Free host or no sequence
    FINAL --> STABLE_HOST: 24h rewrite complete

Preliminary accept/reject and owner cancel serialize by requestRevision; exact replay keeps the original receipt while the current view may be newer; no duplicate request, campaign copy, seat or capacity reservation.
REJECTED safe-return changes only the local cursor; the owning historical request and immutable receipt survive return/reconnect, and a new submit requires a fresh explicit command.

CANCELLED requests and their immutable receipts remain in durable history but are excluded from the current requests[] queue. If a selected request becomes CANCELLED, the next authoritative queue snapshot clears selectedRequestIdOrNull to null; replay/reconnect does not restore the removed selection. Only the verified owner sees this complete immutable published proposal: the submitting device owner for DEVICE_REQUEST, or the committed NET-028 claimant for MASTER_IMPORT. ACCEPT or DECLINE applies to all 1..3 copies, never a subset. ACCEPT revalidates the proposal revision/checksum, current capacity and exclusive controller in the same transaction; failure writes nothing. DECLINE needs no invented free-text reason and activates no copy or slot.

For a PAUSED campaign, successful ACCEPT publishes only the owning NET-006 admitted lobby context, including every blocker; it does not navigate to PLY-001, mark Ready or activate a scene. The existing NET-006 Start-confirmed boundary owns the later PLY-001 transition.

Owner decision #199 B, 2026-11-01: PROPOSED copies reserve no capacity. Whole-batch player ACCEPT occupies one campaign place for every admitted copy, including lobby-only copies with pending mass/property blockers. Those blockers still prohibit active/Ready/scene. Capacity recheck counts all occupied admission places, not only currently active PCs. DECLINE activates no copy or place. Concurrent ACCEPT operations for the last place serialize in one host transaction; the losing batch remains unadmitted with no partial controller/group assignment.

Closed controllerDeviceRecheck fields: ownerProvenance, controllerBindings, valid, evaluatedCampaignRevision. Each controller binding has campaignCharacterId, deviceId, localControllerSeatId, inputLaneId. Device/key/owned lane come from the authenticated original submission or committed NET-028 owner claim, according to admissionOrigin, and current host state, never a browser authority claim; duplicate controller or foreign/retired lane fails atomically.

Only a pending published proposal accepts a new player decision. After terminal ACCEPT or DECLINE, reopening the proposal is read-only; a new/opposite command performs zero writes. Exact replay of the original command returns its original receipt separately from the current lobby/result view, without recreating groups, places, profiles or controller bindings.

Closed ownerProvenance variants: DEVICE_REQUEST={kind,requestId,requestOwnerDeviceId}; MASTER_IMPORT={kind,candidateId,ownerClaimReceiptId,claimingPlayerId,controllingDeviceId,controllerSeat}. Values come only from the verified original submission or committed NET-028 owner claim respectively. admissionOrigin equals ownerProvenance.kind. Where present on the form, requestIdOrNull and reviewRevisionOrNull are non-null for DEVICE_REQUEST and null for MASTER_IMPORT; ordinary draft decisions use reviewRevision, published player decisions use proposalRevision. MASTER_IMPORT uses its actual candidate, claim, existing campaignCharacterId and proposal revision. No false submission/validation receipt is created for an import. Current GM authority, full-batch decision, capacity and exclusive-controller checks apply to both origins. This preserves the supplied import contract; runtime #172 still implements DEVICE_REQUEST only.

Назначение реализовано буквально: Read-only механика, UUID/provenance и натуральные броски каждого immutable source; отдельная адресованная рабочая review copy до создания campaignCharacterId, либо уже опубликованная PROPOSED copy.

Ordinary review scope: requestStatus=IN_REVIEW remains unchanged by review opening or draft edits; GM_REVIEW is the separate review phase. Stable reviewCopyId addresses one immutable submitted sourceUuid/snapshot/checksum. campaignCharacterId is null until GM-ACCEPT; the published reviewCopyId-to-campaignCharacterId mapping is immutable.

Review drafts are durable, host-validated uncommitted input, never confirmed mechanics or player authority. DEVICE_REQUEST checks exact expected reviewRevision and campaign/request/GM scope; MASTER_IMPORT checks its actual candidate/owner-claim/copy scope and current proposal revision. An unknown field, stale edit or changed replay is rejected. Navigation alone does not publish a copy or commit admission.

For DEVICE_REQUEST only, draft editing and weapon staging require IN_REVIEW plus GM_REVIEW and no published proposal. GM-ACCEPT freezes the draft and complete diff. Preliminary rejection revokes workspace access without deleting history; every queued edit/publication rechecks the request. MASTER_IMPORT retains its existing owner-claimed PROPOSED copy review before final diff publication; an imported PROPOSED lifecycle alone is not proof that its diff was already published. Both origins become read-only after final diff publication.

Closed reviewScope variants: ORDINARY_DRAFT={kind,admissionBatchId,requestId,reviewCopyId,reviewRevision}; IMPORTED_REVIEW={kind,admissionBatchId,campaignCharacterId,candidateId,ownerClaimReceiptId,proposalRevision}; PUBLISHED_COPY={kind,admissionBatchId,campaignCharacterId,proposalRevision,origin,requestIdOrNull,reviewCopyIdOrNull}. ORDINARY_DRAFT has no campaignCharacterId. IMPORTED_REVIEW preserves the real OWNER_CLAIMED candidate and existing PROPOSED copy from J-GM-IMPORT-ADMISSION; sole current GM may finalize it before its final diff is published, with current proposal revision and no fabricated ordinary request/review identity. VALIDATED_REQUEST additionally requires the original requestId/validationReceiptId; ADMISSION_GRANT instead uses its own new reviewItemId and closed grant input, without a fabricated player request. Owner decision #199 B, 2026-11-01: PROPOSED copies reserve no capacity. Whole-batch player ACCEPT occupies one campaign place for every admitted copy, including lobby-only copies with pending mass/property blockers. Those blockers still prohibit active/Ready/scene. Capacity recheck counts all occupied admission places, not only currently active PCs. DECLINE activates no copy or place. Concurrent ACCEPT operations for the last place serialize in one host transaction; the losing batch remains unadmitted with no partial controller/group assignment.

Closed statAdjustments: exactly S,D,M,Z,I,W,C signed integer corrections, validated by AQ2-002 and existing stat bounds. Closed startingSkills: entries only; each ordered unique entry contains skillKey and targetBonus, validated with CORE-165 and the existing source pool, costs and requirements. No assumed bonus of 1; free grants are retained from immutable source and cannot be supplied as edits. Unknown stat/skill keys are rejected.

Closed massReview: massKg, decision=PENDING_MASTER_APPROVAL|APPROVED. Closed moneyReview: status=PENDING|FINAL, amountOrNull; PENDING requires null amount, FINAL requires an explicit finite nonnegative amount of existing RES-CUR-000 (zero allowed), not a guessed conversion of the immutable D20 recommendation. No new denomination or currency is introduced.

Closed inventoryReview: status=PENDING|FINAL, entries, unresolvedSourceEntryIds. Each entry has reviewItemId, sourceEntryIdOrNull, item, quantity, qualityLabel, weaponDecisionReceiptIdOrNull. item is CATALOG={kind,itemTypeId} or CUSTOM_ITEM={kind,name,description,statBonusOrNull}; statBonusOrNull is null or {statCode,positiveIntegerBonus} under Q-CHAR-019. Quantity follows Item instance-model INTEGER>=1; zero means absence of an entry, not a zero stack. Catalog/quality values obey supplied registries; descriptive quality alone has no mechanical bonus. Original entry references are immutable source entries, new reviewItemIds are stable host-owned IDs, unknown/foreign/duplicate refs fail. FINAL requires an explicit completed inventory (possibly empty) and no unresolved mandatory source entries; PENDING preserves each unresolved entry as a visible blocker. A weapon profile comes only from its bound immutable source or verified staged decision, never arbitrary browser profile bytes.

Closed weaponDecisionRefs variants: VALIDATED_REQUEST={kind,requestId,validationReceiptId,decisionReceiptId}; ADMISSION_GRANT={kind,reviewItemId,decisionReceiptId}. For ORDINARY_DRAFT, all refer to host-verified staged decisions bound to this reviewCopyId and the exact validated request or new admission grant respectively. Unknown, foreign or changed references fail. Existing unresolved typed requests must still be explicitly resolved; inventory replacement never silently discards one.

Closed blocker fields: kind, reviewCopyIdOrNull, campaignCharacterIdOrNull, sourceEntryIdOrNull, message. kind=MASS_PENDING requires null sourceEntryId; kind=STARTING_PROPERTY_PENDING names an unresolved immutable source property entry or explicit money/inventory review, using sourceEntryIdOrNull=null only for the aggregate review. These are lobby blockers only; source/schema/skill/stat/weapon/controller/capacity invalidity is a structural validation failure, never disguised as an admissible blocker. Player messages contain no internal rule IDs, private witness or unrelated source.

Draft selection alone cannot create a live weapon instance.

IMPORTED_REVIEW preserves the real OWNER_CLAIMED candidate and existing PROPOSED copy from J-GM-IMPORT-ADMISSION; sole current GM may finalize it before its final diff is published, with current proposal revision and no fabricated ordinary request/review identity. PUBLISHED_COPY means the final diff was published and is read-only for both origins; DEVICE_REQUEST requires original request/review IDs, MASTER_IMPORT retains actual candidate/owner-claim provenance and null ordinary request/review IDs. Existing PROPOSED import ingress guards are preserved.

Closed review draft fields: statAdjustments, startingSkills, massReview, inventoryReview, moneyReview, weaponDecisionRefs, groupAssignment, locationAssignment. All original FINAL base values, natural rolls, provenance, source bytes and free racial/class grants remain read-only.

statAdjustments follow AQ2-002: permanent GM corrections to the accepted base followed by existing race/class/symbiont/bounds/derived recalculation, every final stat at least 1. startingSkills may add/remove/replace only editable starting skills within source requirements and capacity; no universal training or free-grant edits.

massReview follows AQA-010: positive kilograms at 0.1 precision, no invented PC race min/max; explicit PENDING_MASTER_APPROVAL or APPROVED. inventoryReview and moneyReview follow AQ2-004 and item registry types: final item, quantity, descriptive quality, effective weapon profile and money; empty categories and zero money allowed, unfinished review is not silently finalized. Granted items remain UNEQUIPPED per Q-CHAR-014.

Complete diff covers every source-to-proposal mechanical change, identity mapping, master correction, skill replacement, mass approval, inventory item/quantity/quality/profile, money and group/location assignment. A no-change section is explicit. Player and GM see the same complete published batch diff and blockers; player payload omits GM-private review context, private provenance witnesses, keys and internal rule IDs.

Structural validation failure blocks GM publication and player ACCEPT. Pending mass or mandatory starting-property approval is a visible Ready/active/scene blocker, not a fabricated successful review. Unresolved typed weapon requests still block batch finalization under NET-019. No automatic equipment, Ready, Start, scene, combat, group-transfer or general inventory runtime is implied.

Closed groupAssignment variants: EXISTING={kind,groupId}; NEW={kind,groupDraftId,name}; START={kind}. groupDraftId is a stable host-issued batch-scoped identity independent of the displayed name: two copies share a new group only through the same groupDraftId; equal names never merge identities. locationAssignment={location,subLocationOrNull} contains explicit GM display labels, never inferred coordinates/scene/clock/marker. NEW/START has no fabricated groupId before player ACCEPT. Player ACCEPT atomically creates or reuses the unique campaign starting-group/new-group identity and records the assignment with the whole batch; EXISTING is revalidated. Replay preserves group IDs and mappings; Start reuses them rather than creating replacements. Admission assignment alone does not activate a scene or grant Ready.

GM-ACCEPT publishes all reviewed copies, complete diffs/checksum and the original immutable receipt atomically or publishes none. For DEVICE_REQUEST campaignCharacterIds are allocated once at this commit; MASTER_IMPORT preserves its existing source-backed PROPOSED copy IDs and publishes their final diff without replacement allocation. No player authority is granted until the whole-batch player decision. A technical failure rolls back every created copy/profile; repeated commandId returns the original receipt separately from current view.

allRequiredFieldsValid means a structurally valid complete batch including explicit pending statuses; it does not erase source-permitted lobby blockers or claim Ready. Unknown or invalid source, typed weapon request or controller/capacity proof blocks the commit.

Owner decision #199 B, 2026-11-01: PROPOSED copies reserve no capacity. Whole-batch player ACCEPT occupies one campaign place for every admitted copy, including lobby-only copies with pending mass/property blockers. Those blockers still prohibit active/Ready/scene. Capacity recheck counts all occupied admission places, not only currently active PCs. DECLINE activates no copy or place. Concurrent ACCEPT operations for the last place serialize in one host transaction; the losing batch remains unadmitted with no partial controller/group assignment.

Closed capacityPreview/capacityRecheck fields: activePlayerCapacity, occupiedCampaignPlaceCount, activePcCount, candidateCount, fitsCurrentCapacity, evaluatedCampaignRevision. Candidate count equals the complete batch size; fits uses occupiedCampaignPlaceCount plus candidateCount against capacity, with replay excluding its already committed places. This is a fresh proof, not a reservation.

Closed fullCampaignCopyDiff row fields: sourceUuid, sourceSnapshotChecksum, reviewCopyIdOrNull, campaignCharacterIdOrNull, characterName, beforeSheet, afterSheet, changes, blockers. beforeSheet and afterSheet are complete owner-visible mechanical sheets with the same fixed source-backed projection schema; hidden provenance witness and GM-private metadata are excluded. changes rows have section, fieldPath, beforeValue, afterValue; section is STATS|SKILLS|MASS|INVENTORY|MONEY|GROUP_LOCATION, and fieldPath/value types must match that closed mechanical sheet schema. Host recomputes the exhaustive diff from the immutable source and fully validated proposal; clients cannot submit arbitrary diff rows. Unchanged sections are explicit through identical before/after values. Full ordered batch, review revision, mappings and blockers bind the canonical proposalChecksum; partial or mismatched diff is rejected.

beforeSheet/afterSheet use the versioned AdmissionMechanicalSheetV1 contract in ADR 0071: identical closed schema for source/proposal, including full derived resources, skill bonuses and slot costs, inventory profiles/quality/quantity, money, group/location and unchanged mechanical sections. A delta of editable inputs alone is not a complete sheet.

Closed ownerProvenance variants: DEVICE_REQUEST={kind,requestId,requestOwnerDeviceId}; MASTER_IMPORT={kind,candidateId,ownerClaimReceiptId,claimingPlayerId,controllingDeviceId,controllerSeat}. Values come only from the verified original submission or committed NET-028 owner claim respectively. admissionOrigin equals ownerProvenance.kind. Where present on the form, requestIdOrNull and reviewRevisionOrNull are non-null for DEVICE_REQUEST and null for MASTER_IMPORT; ordinary draft decisions use reviewRevision, published player decisions use proposalRevision. MASTER_IMPORT uses its actual candidate, claim, existing campaignCharacterId and proposal revision. No false submission/validation receipt is created for an import. Current GM authority, full-batch decision, capacity and exclusive-controller checks apply to both origins. This preserves the supplied import contract; runtime #172 still implements DEVICE_REQUEST only.

fullCampaignCopyDiff.reviewCopyIdOrNull is the stable reviewCopyId for DEVICE_REQUEST and null for MASTER_IMPORT, whose candidate/claim/copy provenance remains in ownerProvenance. Both full sheets and the immutable proposal checksum remain mandatory.

actions.ctaAvailability: CTA существует только при выполненных entry/guard conditions и актуальных revisions.
allowed: Только операции, перечисленные в references.operationIds либо соответствующей journey.

Частичный commit, повторный расход ресурса, повторный бросок или скрытая автоматизация tombstone-правила.
Выдача игроку GM-only данных либо внутренних Rule ID в игровом сообщении.

states.loading: Данные ещё не готовы; mutation CTA отсутствуют.
states.empty: Показывается объяснимое отсутствие данных и только разрешённый следующий шаг.
states.ready: Показана подтверждённая сервером либо локальным хранилищем ревизия.
states.submitting: Одна команда отправлена; повтор с тем же commandId идемпотентен.
states.success: Показан подтверждённый результат и новая stateRevision.
states.validationError: Состояние не меняется; ошибка связана с полем и объяснена без внутренних Rule ID игроку.
states.conflict: Конфликт revision либо повторное использование ID с другим payload отклонены до расхода.
states.connectionLost: Новые mutation-команды блокированы; доступен безопасный просмотр последней подтверждённой проекции.
states.reconnecting: Восстанавливаются server-authoritative seat, projection и pending command.
states.restored: Показана серверная подтверждённая ревизия без повторного броска или расхода.

transitionsIn.guard: Системные 44 шаблона read-only; campaign custom versioned.
System clone, user versioning and blocker branches are mutually selected from the catalog and each returns without forcing another branch.

transitionsOut.guard: safe boundary or completed child context
safe boundary or completed child context

legacyCatalogTrace.granularity: legacy catalog page-group; not an exact per-form mapping

projection.controller: Показывает только данные и команды, разрешённые effectiveController и controllerSeat.
projection.observer: Скрывает GM-only и actor-invisible данные до сериализации player projection.

auditAtomicity.command: Mutation имеет commandId/operationId и выполняется атомарно после повторной серверной проверки guards.
auditAtomicity.audit: Для изменения хранить actor/author, timestamp, before/after, reason/source и итоговую revision.
auditAtomicity.reconnect: Восстанавливать только server-confirmed state; незавершённый commit не повторяет бросок или расход.

accessibility.keyboard: Полная навигация клавиатурой; логичный focus order и возврат фокуса после dialog/overlay.
accessibility.screenReader: Название, состояние, ошибки и изменения объявляются; скрытые команды отсутствуют в accessibility tree.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Каждая анимация имеет краткий статический/opacity-вариант без потери результата и тайминга правила.
accessibility.contrast: Контраст не ниже WCAG AA; состояние не кодируется только цветом.

acceptanceCriteria: ENM-003 достижим только в разрешённой роли/сцене и имеет явный безопасный выход либо системное завершение.
Loading/empty/error/conflict/connection-lost/reconnect не приводят к частичному commit.
Player projection не содержит скрытых GM-данных или недопустимых executable-команд.
Идемпотентный повтор не создаёт второго результата, броска, XP или расхода.
Назначение реализовано буквально: Read-only данные из закреплённой в кампании версии каталога; изменение, скрытие, архивирование и удаление недоступны.
Все перечисленные requiredFields валидируются до первой записи; неперечисленный OperationID недоступен.

Назначение реализовано буквально: Два взаимоисключающих режима: PATCH_EXISTING создаёт новую версию существующего weapon instance; REQUEST_REVIEW рассматривает валидированную заявку или, только для admission draft, выдачу нового оружия из каталога. Существующая campaign copy получает UNEQUIPPED WeaponProfileVersion; рабочая review copy получает staged profile/receipt, материализуемый один раз при GM-ACCEPT. Выдача нового типа сохраняет исходные заявки и не использует вымышленный validation receipt.
Все перечисленные requiredFields валидируются до первой записи; неперечисленный OperationID недоступен.

REQUEST_REVIEW is bound either to an existing campaignCharacterId or, for pre-publication admission, to reviewCopyId plus the closed weaponReviewInput and current reviewRevision. The latter stores one staged typed decision, profile and receipt without a live inventory instance; GM-ACCEPT atomically materializes the complete UNEQUIPPED WeaponProfileVersion and immutable source-to-copy mapping. APPROVE keeps the validated profile; MASTER_OVERRIDE requires a reason and CORE-187/188/190 typed fields. PATCH_EXISTING still requires a real existing campaignCharacterId/weaponInstanceId and is never available for a review-only copy.

Closed weaponOwnerScope variants: CAMPAIGN_COPY={kind,campaignCharacterId}; ADMISSION_REVIEW={kind,admissionBatchId,requestId,reviewCopyId,reviewRevision}. ADMISSION_REVIEW requires mode=REQUEST_REVIEW and weaponInstanceIdOrNull=null, profileVersionBeforeOrNull=null; preview is a staged decision/profile, not a live inventory instance. An unchanged staged decision replays its original receipt; a changed or opposite decision conflicts. The original validated request remains immutable.

ADMISSION_REVIEW weapon resolve rechecks sole GM authority, owning requestStatus=IN_REVIEW, review phase=GM_REVIEW, exact reviewRevision and the request or grant input selected by weaponReviewInput and absence of a published proposal inside the same transaction. Preliminary reject, GM publication, foreign scope or stale revision causes zero new write. Published draft/profile/receipt is immutable; direct navigation or a retained weapon dialog cannot bypass the freeze.

Closed weaponReviewInput variants: VALIDATED_REQUEST={kind,requestId,validationReceiptId}; ADMISSION_GRANT={kind,reviewItemId,weaponTypeId,profileSource,reason}. ADMISSION_GRANT is admission-only, requires a new stable reviewItemId, mode=REQUEST_REVIEW, decision=MASTER_OVERRIDE, non-empty reason and null requestIdOrNull/validationReceiptIdOrNull/commonWitness; it never invents a player request or changes an existing instance type. profileSource is CATALOG_TEMPLATE={kind,templateId} only when the exact supplied template has a complete profile, otherwise GM_DEFINED={kind,typedProfile} validated under CORE-187/188/190 with all required fields and immutable audit. Host derives the canonical template profile or validates the complete typed input; missing fields never receive guessed defaults. Replacing a source weapon creates a distinct proposed item/profile and preserves the removed source entry and original request decision in history. Draft selection alone cannot create a live weapon instance.

weaponReviewInputOrNull is null only for mode=PATCH_EXISTING, which keeps its existing instance/profile inputs. mode=REQUEST_REVIEW requires exactly one closed VALIDATED_REQUEST or ADMISSION_GRANT input; no fabricated request or grant is used for PATCH_EXISTING.

ADMISSION_GRANT prepares only admission draft data: operationId=null, no OP-REQ-GM player-request decision and no general live OP-GM-GIVE commit. The final GM-ACCEPT materialization enforces the supplied CORE-183/187/188/190 grant contract and audit. Existing VALIDATED_REQUEST and PATCH_EXISTING keep their original operation mappings and guards.

Ordinary review scope: requestStatus=IN_REVIEW remains unchanged by review opening or draft edits; GM_REVIEW is the separate review phase. Stable reviewCopyId addresses one immutable submitted sourceUuid/snapshot/checksum. campaignCharacterId is null until GM-ACCEPT; the published reviewCopyId-to-campaignCharacterId mapping is immutable.

Review drafts are durable, host-validated uncommitted input, never confirmed mechanics or player authority. DEVICE_REQUEST checks exact expected reviewRevision and campaign/request/GM scope; MASTER_IMPORT checks its actual candidate/owner-claim/copy scope and current proposal revision. An unknown field, stale edit or changed replay is rejected. Navigation alone does not publish a copy or commit admission.

For DEVICE_REQUEST only, draft editing and weapon staging require IN_REVIEW plus GM_REVIEW and no published proposal. GM-ACCEPT freezes the draft and complete diff. Preliminary rejection revokes workspace access without deleting history; every queued edit/publication rechecks the request. MASTER_IMPORT retains its existing owner-claimed PROPOSED copy review before final diff publication; an imported PROPOSED lifecycle alone is not proof that its diff was already published. Both origins become read-only after final diff publication.

Closed reviewScope variants: ORDINARY_DRAFT={kind,admissionBatchId,requestId,reviewCopyId,reviewRevision}; IMPORTED_REVIEW={kind,admissionBatchId,campaignCharacterId,candidateId,ownerClaimReceiptId,proposalRevision}; PUBLISHED_COPY={kind,admissionBatchId,campaignCharacterId,proposalRevision,origin,requestIdOrNull,reviewCopyIdOrNull}. ORDINARY_DRAFT has no campaignCharacterId. IMPORTED_REVIEW preserves the real OWNER_CLAIMED candidate and existing PROPOSED copy from J-GM-IMPORT-ADMISSION; sole current GM may finalize it before its final diff is published, with current proposal revision and no fabricated ordinary request/review identity. PUBLISHED_COPY means the final diff was published and is read-only for both origins; DEVICE_REQUEST requires original request/review IDs, MASTER_IMPORT retains actual candidate/owner-claim provenance and null ordinary request/review IDs. Existing PROPOSED import ingress guards are preserved.

Closed review draft fields: statAdjustments, startingSkills, massReview, inventoryReview, moneyReview, weaponDecisionRefs, groupAssignment, locationAssignment. All original FINAL base values, natural rolls, provenance, source bytes and free racial/class grants remain read-only.

statAdjustments follow AQ2-002: permanent GM corrections to the accepted base followed by existing race/class/symbiont/bounds/derived recalculation, every final stat at least 1. startingSkills may add/remove/replace only editable starting skills within source requirements and capacity; no universal training or free-grant edits.

massReview follows AQA-010: positive kilograms at 0.1 precision, no invented PC race min/max; explicit PENDING_MASTER_APPROVAL or APPROVED. inventoryReview and moneyReview follow AQ2-004 and item registry types: final item, quantity, descriptive quality, effective weapon profile and money; empty categories and zero money allowed, unfinished review is not silently finalized. Granted items remain UNEQUIPPED per Q-CHAR-014.

Complete diff covers every source-to-proposal mechanical change, identity mapping, master correction, skill replacement, mass approval, inventory item/quantity/quality/profile, money and group/location assignment. A no-change section is explicit. Player and GM see the same complete published batch diff and blockers; player payload omits GM-private review context, private provenance witnesses, keys and internal rule IDs.

Structural validation failure blocks GM publication and player ACCEPT. Pending mass or mandatory starting-property approval is a visible Ready/active/scene blocker, not a fabricated successful review. Unresolved typed weapon requests still block batch finalization under NET-019. No automatic equipment, Ready, Start, scene, combat, group-transfer or general inventory runtime is implied.

No effectInstanceId, EffectTypeID or duration/stackPolicy is required or fabricated for starting-skill admission. This form edits only the selected review draft under AQ2-002, not the immutable source, free grants or general progression.

actions.ctaAvailability: CTA существует только при выполненных entry/guard conditions и актуальных revisions.
allowed: Только операции, перечисленные в references.operationIds либо соответствующей journey.

Разрешённые mutation OperationID этой формы: OP-ABILITY-COMBAT.
Разрешённые atlas workflow commands этой формы: UI-CMD-COMBAT-SINGLE-ACTION-DECLARE.

Разрешённые видимые действия/CTA именно этой формы: Выбрать одиночное действие противника; Продолжить к допустимой цели противника; Создать автоматический запрос одиночного действия; Создать ручной запрос одиночного действия; Разрешить детерминированное одиночное действие; Создать серию действий противника; Вернуться к общему chooser.
prohibited: Mutation из неверной роли, чужого controllerSeat или устаревшей projectionRevision.
Частичный commit, повторный расход ресурса, повторный бросок или скрытая автоматизация tombstone-правила.
Выдача игроку GM-only данных либо внутренних Rule ID в игровом сообщении.
Форма не может отправить иной OperationID; projected OperationID и наличие RuleID в references сами по себе не создают CTA.
Любой CTA, route target или same-form command, отсутствующий в visible и ctaAvailabilityByAction этой записи, запрещён.
actions.dynamicAvailability: Executable chooser получает только server-authoritative availableActions; недоступные действия, цели и параметры отсутствуют в payload, DOM и accessibility tree.

availabilityContract.visibleSemantics: visible is the curated primary CTA vocabulary; ctaAvailabilityByAction is the exhaustive route/command vocabulary. At runtime either kind exists only while its own per-action guard evaluates true.
availabilityContract.closedDiagnostics: Failed reasons are available only in GM/QA actionAvailabilityTrace and never serialized to a player/effective-controller projection.

forms.title: Разрешение атаки
forms.purpose: Разрешает ровно один текущий typed элемент подтверждённой серии/одиночной команды. После atomic commit следующий элемент dispatch-ится по immutable resolutionKind: ROLL — в его AUTO/MANUAL request, DETERMINISTIC — обратно в resolver; chooser/end-turn открываются только после COMPLETE/RECONCILED_REJECTED.

guardStates: current entry belongs to the same immutable seriesId/commandId/order

next stage follows nextResolutionKind without client route choice
chooser/end-turn/ambush return requires no unresolved entry or pending request
components: Содержательная область: Разрешает ровно один текущий typed элемент подтверждённой серии/одиночной команды. actions.ctaAvailability: CTA существует только при выполненных entry/guard conditions и актуальных revisions.
allowed: Только операции, перечисленные в references.operationIds либо соответствующей journey.
Идемпотентный повтор того же commandId с тем же payload возвращает прежний результат.

Разрешённые видимые действия/CTA именно этой формы: Открыть «Универсальная атака ближнего боя»; Открыть «Универсальная дальняя атака»; Открыть «Способность симбионта»; Открыть «Площадь действия»; Открыть «Запрос реакции»; Открыть «Результат брони и щита»; Открыть «Эффект наложен или снят»; Открыть «Боеприпасы и состояние оружия»; Открыть «Атомарная перезарядка»; Открыть «Покрытие оружия или снаряда»; Открыть «Runtime-объекты на поле боя»; Открыть «Подобрать или вернуть runtime-предмет»; Вернуться к «Управление противником».
prohibited: Mutation из неверной роли, чужого controllerSeat или устаревшей projectionRevision.
Частичный commit, повторный расход ресурса, повторный бросок или скрытая автоматизация tombstone-правила.
Выдача игроку GM-only данных либо внутренних Rule ID в игровом сообщении.
Форма не может отправить иной OperationID; projected OperationID и наличие RuleID в references сами по себе не создают CTA.
Любой CTA, route target или same-form command, отсутствующий в visible и ctaAvailabilityByAction этой записи, запрещён.

availabilityContract.visibleSemantics: visible is the curated primary CTA vocabulary; ctaAvailabilityByAction is the exhaustive route/command vocabulary. At runtime either kind exists only while its own per-action guard evaluates true.
availabilityContract.closedDiagnostics: Failed reasons are available only in GM/QA actionAvailabilityTrace and never serialized to a player/effective-controller projection.

actions.ctaAvailability: CTA существует только при выполненных entry/guard conditions и актуальных revisions.
allowed: Только операции, перечисленные в references.operationIds либо соответствующей journey.

actions.dynamicAvailability: Executable chooser получает только server-authoritative availableActions; недоступные действия, цели и параметры отсутствуют в payload, DOM и accessibility tree.

availabilityContract.visibleSemantics: visible is the curated primary CTA vocabulary; ctaAvailabilityByAction is the exhaustive route/command vocabulary. At runtime either kind exists only while its own per-action guard evaluates true.
availabilityContract.closedDiagnostics: Failed reasons are available only in GM/QA actionAvailabilityTrace and never serialized to a player/effective-controller projection.

acceptanceCriteria: SYS-016 достижим только в разрешённой роли/сцене и имеет явный безопасный выход либо системное завершение.
Loading/empty/error/conflict/connection-lost/reconnect не приводят к частичному commit.
Player projection не содержит скрытых GM-данных или недопустимых executable-команд.
Идемпотентный повтор не создаёт второго результата, броска, XP или расхода.

Назначение реализовано буквально: Исключительный stale/conflict-баннер после серверной предфиксационной проверки: объясняет изменение человеческим текстом без внутренних RuleID, ничего не списывает и возвращает только к server-signed исходному chooser с уже обновлённой проекцией. Эта форма возникает только при stale envelope, direct-invalid request, conflicting ID либо изменении состояния между показом и commit; она не заменяет штатную фильтрацию меню.
Все перечисленные requiredFields валидируются до первой записи; неперечисленный OperationID недоступен.

states.success: Показан подтверждённый результат и новая stateRevision.
states.validationError: Состояние не меняется; ошибка связана с полем и объяснена без внутренних Rule ID игроку.

states.PENDING_DECISION: Ресурсы не зарезервированы; доступны только Accept/Decline.

states.ready: Показана подтверждённая сервером либо локальным хранилищем ревизия.
states.submitting: Одна команда отправлена; повтор с тем же commandId идемпотентен.
states.success: Показан подтверждённый результат и новая stateRevision.
states.validationError: Состояние не меняется; ошибка связана с полем и объяснена без внутренних Rule ID игроку.
states.conflict: Конфликт revision либо повторное использование ID с другим payload отклонены до расхода.
states.connectionLost: Новые mutation-команды блокированы; доступен безопасный просмотр последней подтверждённой проекции.
states.reconnecting: Восстанавливаются server-authoritative seat, projection и pending command.
states.restored: Показана серверная подтверждённая ревизия без повторного броска или расхода.
states.IMPORTED_LOCAL_COPY: Создан новый local UUID с сохранённым provenance.
states.PENDING_OWNER_LINK: GM-import создал только candidate без slot/authority и требует NET-028.
states.INCOMPATIBLE_REPORT: Показан полный read-only отчёт, созданных записей нет.
states.NO_PARTIAL_COMMIT: Любая ошибка оставляет import transaction пустой.

acceptanceCriteria: CHR-045 достижим только в разрешённой роли/сцене и имеет явный безопасный выход либо системное завершение.

states.FINAL_CONFIGURATION: Явно подтверждён окончательный состав; невосстановленные исходные шаблоны удалены необратимо.

qaScenarios.scenario: For each special player screen remove the corresponding symbiont/lifecycle and inspect route, action projection, DOM, a11y, hotkeys and cache.
qaScenarios.expected: The screen CTA and every screen-specific field are absent; direct URL cannot disclose or activate it.

qaScenarios.scenario: Select an eligible body containing multiple formerly hidden symbionts.
qaScenarios.expected: Exactly that body's complete list shows species name, level and current OE for every symbiont; no random-victim branch or unrelated body data exists.

qaScenarios.scenario: Resolve greater, lower and equal current-OE cases, including stale revision and reconnect.
qaScenarios.expected: Each strict outcome and OE delta follows Q-SYM-074/CQA-019 once; equality expels and blocks same-turn retry; replay is idempotent.

qaScenarios.scenario: Win one duel, tie another, pause for OE recovery, resume, leave a resident symbiont and finalize.
qaScenarios.expected: One fitting saved species is reserved per win with fixed random receipt; pause preserves state; finalization irreversibly discards only unrecovered templates.

qaScenarios.scenario: Complete one app-run Devouring, replay its receipt, then interrupt another before completion.
qaScenarios.expected: The completed event automatically and atomically updates rewards/history/count/slot once without GM confirmation; interruption gives no history or reward.

qaScenarios.scenario: Compare player and GM projections before and after every threshold crossing.
qaScenarios.expected: GM sees the three intervals and sums; player sees only count/history/open slots and never threshold values or distance to next threshold.

qaScenarios.scenario: Record a proven external event twice and attempt to submit an app-runtime receipt through the GM form.
qaScenarios.expected: The first external event increments once; duplicate and app-runtime receipt produce zero write.

qaScenarios.scenario: Monitor known, unknown, on-map, off-map, alive, dead and unavailable infected targets across revision changes.
qaScenarios.expected: Each row shows only known identity, seven characteristics, alive/available/offMap/currentHP and infection status; no coordinate, maxHP, inventory or unrelated hidden effect leaks.

qaScenarios.scenario: For an infected off-map target evaluate MON-049 ('Вы больны…') first with all ability predicates true, then with one predicate false, after a revision change and after reconnect.
qaScenarios.expected: MON-049 is present in the PLY-035 signed AbilityID/availableAction allowlist and opens the combat chooser only while legal; a failed or stale predicate removes the action from payload, DOM, a11y, hotkeys and cache without losing the monitoring row.

qaScenarios.scenario: Destroy assistants free/out-of-turn after another action declaration and after an effect has already fully resolved.
qaScenarios.expected: Active assistants are removed once without action/OE cost; a separate disease and completed effect remain; stale/foreign IDs change nothing.

qaScenarios.scenario: In peace open own location with a known marker, then with hidden/unknown location and after reconnect.
qaScenarios.expected: The player sees the observer-safe own marker or explicit unknown state and safely returns to PLY-001; GM-only notes/markers never leak.

qaScenarios.scenario: Evaluate the known-marker and unknown/hidden-marker branches at the same revision and after a visibility change.
qaScenarios.expected: Exactly one branch is available: VISIBLE with a current marker opens MAP-006; UNKNOWN/HIDDEN with a null marker projection opens MAP-007 and exposes no correlatable coordinate or marker metadata.

qaScenarios.scenario: Allocate the same unallocated amount for a Free carrier and a non-Free carrier, then replay and submit a stale race snapshot.
qaScenarios.expected: Both debit amount once; the Free symbiont receives amount×2 and every other race amount×1; replay/stale input never reapplies the multiplier.

qaScenarios.scenario: Save one short clarification before a linked roll, replay it, then try a stale version and a post-roll replacement.
qaScenarios.expected: Exactly one append-only version and receipt commit without gameplay delta; replay returns it and stale/post-roll submissions write nothing.

qaScenarios.scenario: Complete and interrupt app-run Devouring while inspecting actions, system events and GM controls.
qaScenarios.expected: Only the application system handler commits a valid completion and publishes its receipt; no completion CTA or GM confirmation exists, while the ordinary combat declaration remains available through MON-004.

qaScenarios.scenario: Enumerate every executable operation and locate its typed CTA, required payload, guards, commit receipt and reconnect path.
qaScenarios.expected: Every EXECUTE binding is reachable through an explicit command; preparation/projection forms cannot impersonate execution.

qaScenarios.scenario: Submit a validated custom weapon request, admit its campaign copy and resolve it as GM, including stale and rejected variants.
qaScenarios.expected: The common witness and formula proof survive end to end; no weapon instance is created before GM resolution and an idempotent receipt.

qaScenarios.scenario: Create a sentient enemy and arbitrary monster, then attempt unsupported monster attack fields.
qaScenarios.expected: Mass/anatomy/composition and monster physics are complete; category, melee distance and cost=1 are fixed, while unsupported range/hit/targeting/custom-cost fields are rejected.

qaScenarios.scenario: Apply bleeding and burning through their typed forms, then try to add trace-only, orphaned, derived and source-owned container effects through GM-014.
qaScenarios.expected: Bleeding/burning commit once; excluded effect types are absent from the selectable allowlist and rejected before write.

qaScenarios.scenario: Replay R-001..R-025 and EV-01..EV-12 over battle/group ties, border jitter, entry openers, missing assets, save/load and reconnect.
qaScenarios.expected: The exact determining IDs/evidence, precedence, hysteresis, opener/continuation, shuffle bag and RNG state produce a deterministic same-pool result or justified silence.

qaScenarios.scenario: Выполнить UI-CMD-DEVICE-REQUEST-ACCEPT-TO-REVIEW только из NET-017 с собственной sole-GM authority, затем exact replay, changed payload, stale request revision, restart и проигранную гонку с cancel/другим решением.
qaScenarios.expected: Change exactly one request PENDING→IN_REVIEW, increment requestRevision once and append one decision receipt; do not create campaign copies, campaign seats, capacity reservations or player campaign authority; do not modify campaign checkpoint or local source sheets. Same commandId and payload return the original decision receipt; a current request view may be newer. A concurrent owner cancel or preliminary reject is serialized by requestRevision; the loser performs no write.

qaScenarios.scenario: Выполнить UI-CMD-DEVICE-REQUEST-REJECT только из NET-017 с собственной sole-GM authority, затем exact replay, changed payload, stale request revision, restart и проигранную гонку с cancel/другим решением.
qaScenarios.expected: Change exactly one request PENDING|IN_REVIEW→REJECTED with the non-empty reason, increment requestRevision once and append one decision receipt; preserve candidate snapshot and history; no campaign copy, campaign seat, capacity or local-sheet mutation. Same commandId and payload return the original rejection receipt even if the UI has moved. A changed payload conflicts; stale requestRevision and a concurrent terminal decision perform no write.

qaScenarios.scenario: Два соединения посылают owner cancellation и accept-to-review/reject с одной requestRevision; затем повторить победителя, проигравшего и изменённый payload. Повторить reject после IN_REVIEW и cancel после IN_REVIEW.
qaScenarios.expected: Ровно один commit на исходной revision. PENDING→IN_REVIEW делает последующий cancel недоступным; reasoned reject из IN_REVIEW разрешён новой актуальной revision. Старый receipt неизменен; source sheets/campaign checkpoint/copies/campaign seats/capacity/player authority не изменены. CANCELLED requests and their immutable receipts remain in durable history but are excluded from the current requests[] queue. If a selected request becomes CANCELLED, the next authoritative queue snapshot clears selectedRequestIdOrNull to null; replay/reconnect does not restore the removed selection. REJECTED rows remain displayable under the closed row enum. This projection update does not delete or reset any request.

qaScenarios.scenario: Единственный GM открывает очередь из подтверждённой CMP-006 своей PAUSED кампании, включая ноль заявок, затем возвращается. Проверить чужую campaign, player role, устаревшую authority и forged returnContext.
qaScenarios.expected: Только CMP-006::CTA::002 и NET-017::CTA::009 нового пути; возврат к той же creation receipt/campaign. Никакого Start, CMP-007 или изменения campaign checkpoint; запрещённые CTA отсутствуют в payload/DOM/a11y/hotkeys/cache. CANCELLED requests and their immutable receipts remain in durable history but are excluded from the current requests[] queue. If a selected request becomes CANCELLED, the next authoritative queue snapshot clears selectedRequestIdOrNull to null; replay/reconnect does not restore the removed selection. REJECTED rows remain displayable under the closed row enum. This projection update does not delete or reset any request. The PAUSED requirement belongs to the new CMP-006 ingress/return route. It does not introduce a global PAUSED-only restriction on request-level decisions or alter the guards of other NET-017 entry paths. The preliminary delivery exposes only the CMP-006 capability; other campaign phases and routes remain subject to their separately implemented source guards.

qaScenarios.scenario: После подтверждённого preliminary REJECTED владелец выбирает «Вернуться к выбору персонажей», затем reconnect/restart и replay старого reject receipt. Проверить чужое устройство, PENDING/IN_REVIEW, потерянную technical session и наличие campaign copy/admission.
qaScenarios.expected: Новый NET-005::CTA::003 доступен только при точном guard. Меняется только local presentation cursor. Старые request/receipt сохранены без reset/delete; source sheets и campaign checkpoint не меняются; нет автоматического submit/allocation; запрещённый CTA отсутствует в payload/DOM/a11y/hotkeys/cache.

qaScenarios.scenario: Из NET-017 открыть ordinary IN_REVIEW batch через UI-CMD-ADMISSION-REVIEW-OPEN; проверить exact replay, changed payload, stale revision, потерю GM authority, concurrent reject, restart и неизменность исходных FINAL.
qaScenarios.expected: Create or recover one admissionBatchId and stable reviewCopyIds in GM_REVIEW for this IN_REVIEW request; immutable source and separate draft; requestStatus remains IN_REVIEW. No campaignCharacterId, PROPOSED copy, seat, capacity reservation or player authority. Exact command replay returns the original review-open receipt and IDs with a separate current review view. Changed payload, foreign owner or stale source fails without writes; an existing review is never replaced.

workflowCommands.title: Атомарно сохранить первую версию постоянного НПС
workflowCommands.guards: Все восемь обязательных этапов валидны; UUID ещё не зафиксирован; revision актуальна.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Создать ровно один NPC UUID, version=1, полный snapshot и history entry одной транзакцией.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same commandId возвращает прежнюю квитанцию и не создаёт второго НПС.

workflowCommands.title: Ответить на связанный запрос согласия
workflowCommands.guards: Target owner подтверждён через PLY-030; linked request=PENDING; decision=ACCEPT|DECLINE.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Записать один linked response без резерва ресурса; только положительный ответ разрешает отдельную повторно валидируемую исходную команду.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Закрытие/timeout/disconnect не считаются согласием; повтор ответа идемпотентен.

workflowCommands.title: Ответить на связанный master predicate
workflowCommands.guards: Единственный master authority подтверждён через PLY-030; linked predicate=PENDING; decision=YES|NO.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Записать один linked predicate response без расхода; неизвестно/закрытие блокирует исходную команду.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Повтор того же ответа возвращает receipt; другой ответ с тем же commandId отклоняется.

workflowCommands.title: Импортировать независимую копию персонажа
workflowCommands.guards: CHR-044=COMPATIBLE; checksum/provenance valid; no source UUID collision.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Создать один новый local UUID либо один PENDING_OWNER_LINK candidate; несовместимый импорт создаёт ноль записей.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Повтор importId возвращает прежний receipt.

workflowCommands.title: Принять либо отклонить владение импортированным кандидатом
workflowCommands.guards: candidate=PENDING_OWNER_LINK; claiming owner/device/seat confirmed; no active slot reserved.
workflowCommands.atomicity: CLAIM создаёт одну owner link; DECLINE ничего не допускает и не обходит GM review.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Linked decision идемпотентно восстанавливается.

workflowCommands.title: Отправить device request 1–3 персонажей
workflowCommands.guards: Technical connection established; 1–3 immutable local character snapshots selected.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Создать один AdmissionBatch request без занятия capacity.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same requestId restores NET-005 without duplicate request.

workflowCommands.title: Опубликовать PROPOSED campaign copies AdmissionBatch
workflowCommands.guards: All 1–3 candidates reviewed; required fields complete; GM authority current.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Publish all PROPOSED copies or none; player authority still absent until NET-027.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Batch receipt restores without duplicate copies.

workflowCommands.title: Отклонить AdmissionBatch с причиной
workflowCommands.guards: Batch pending; non-empty reason; GM authority current.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Reject the whole batch; local source sheets remain unchanged.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same decision returns prior receipt.

workflowCommands.title: Принять либо отклонить полный campaign-copy diff
workflowCommands.guards: Whole AdmissionBatch diff loaded; controlling device and capacity revalidated.
workflowCommands.atomicity: ACCEPT admits the whole structurally valid batch or none and occupies one place per copy, including blocked lobby-only copies; recheck occupied places and exclusive controllers atomically. It never marks Ready or activates a scene; PAUSED result is NET-006. DECLINE admits no copy and occupies no place; owner receives the typed NET-007 result without a required reason. Both keep immutable source/proposal and original replay receipts.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Decision receipt restores without duplicate authority.

workflowCommands.title: Создать новую полную версию NPC
workflowCommands.guards: NPC persistent and not archived; active combat keeps pinned prior snapshot.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Keep npcUuid; append version N+1 and history; never mutate prior snapshot.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same version command returns the prior N+1 receipt.

workflowCommands.title: Разрешить временного актора после сцены
workflowCommands.guards: Combat resolution fixed; actor temporary; decision=RELEASE|ADD_NPC|KILL.
workflowCommands.atomicity: RELEASE removes with history; ADD_NPC preserves same UUID/state; KILL enters ordinary death/corpse lifecycle.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Each actor decision is idempotent and mandatory before close.

workflowCommands.title: Сохранить валидный этап черновика боя
workflowCommands.guards: GM authority current; combat=DRAFT; requested stage equals the current sequential checkpoint; every preceding stage receipt is committed; stage-specific validation and draftRevision pass.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Patch exactly one sequential draft stage, advance its checkpoint once and issue its stage receipt without spawning an active actor or starting combat.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Draft revision, current stage and all committed stage receipts restore exactly; generated preview seed is not rerolled and no stage is skipped.

workflowCommands.title: Зафиксировать исход боя
workflowCommands.guards: No unresolved command/reaction; winner=A|B|DRAW and reason non-empty.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Freeze initiative result once and open only the legal loot/disposition branch.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Result receipt restores without reopening initiative.

workflowCommands.title: Подтвердить либо отклонить выход Хранителя
workflowCommands.guards: Eligible dead carrier; guardianDecisionStatus=PENDING; no prior decision or auto-create receipt; lawful player owner active; current death/combat revision.
workflowCommands.atomicity: CONFIRM creates exactly one Guardian actor and creation receipt; DECLINE records one decision receipt while preserving the normative finish-boundary auto-create obligation; neither branch is a bare navigation route.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Pending decision or the exact committed receipt restores without duplicate Guardian; replay never changes CONFIRM to DECLINE or vice versa.

workflowCommands.title: Изменить локальную громкость или mute
workflowCommands.guards: 0<=musicVolume,sfxVolume,uiVolume<=1; local settings context.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Persist the local mixer snapshot; shared game state is untouched.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Refresh restores the last local mixer values.

workflowCommands.title: Завершить кампанию в immutable archive
workflowCommands.guards: Correct GM password; safe boundary; no pending operation; campaign not already completed.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Create final checkpoint and immutable archive once; stop host mutations.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same finish command returns the archive receipt.

workflowCommands.title: Разблокировать передачу мастера
workflowCommands.guards: Correct transfer password; safe boundary; checkpoint complete; one current master.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Create one short-lived successor transfer token without changing authority.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Token state restores or expires closed.

workflowCommands.title: Передать полномочия одному преемнику
workflowCommands.guards: Valid unlock token; successor device acknowledged checkpoint; no pending operation.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Revoke old authority and grant successor in one transaction; never two masters.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Conflict freezes campaign until recovery; commit receipt is idempotent.

workflowCommands.title: Подтвердить полный RP-час Учителя
workflowCommands.guards: Exactly one full eligible hour; GM confirmation; persisted eventId.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Persist one random eligible non-Teacher XP award and audit receipt.
workflowCommands.reconnect: eventId replay never rerolls or awards twice.

workflowCommands.title: Разрешить часовую экспозицию заражения
workflowCommands.guards: One unresolved full-hour exposure; decision and species choice valid.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Resolve exactly one blocking exposure event, including occupied-species handling.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Unresolved event remains blocking; resolved event never repeats.

workflowCommands.title: Сохранить сюжетную пометку без механики
workflowCommands.guards: Safe boundary; note text and reason present; no mechanical payload.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Append one versioned narrative note and audit entry only.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same commandId returns the prior note version.

workflowCommands.title: Подтвердить атомарное продвижение времени
workflowCommands.guards: Preview complete; all blocking events acknowledged; target timestamp unchanged.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Apply the complete event queue or roll back every clock/effect/rest mutation.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same transactionId restores receipt and never reticks.

workflowCommands.title: Запустить либо остановить автоматические часы
workflowCommands.guards: Campaign running/paused transition legal; no combat time freeze conflict.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Persist one clockMode change; dayPhase remains derived read-only.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Clock mode and last confirmed timestamp restore exactly.

workflowCommands.title: Отменить длительный отдых
workflowCommands.guards: Rest active or scheduled; GM authority current; reason present.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Keep elapsed world time, discard only unfinished rest progress according to interruption rules.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Cancel receipt restores without a second reset.

workflowCommands.title: Отменить либо возобновить отдых после боя
workflowCommands.guards: Group rest paused by completed combat; decision=CANCEL|RESUME.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Apply one branch; combat participants start the required new personal sleep segment on RESUME.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Pending decision remains blocking; response is idempotent.

workflowCommands.title: Создать вариант финального локального персонажа
workflowCommands.guards: Source local sheet FINAL; only name/description/art copied.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Create one new draft UUID with no copied random results.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same commandId returns the same variant UUID.

workflowCommands.title: Экспортировать версионированный файл персонажа
workflowCommands.guards: Local sheet or completed campaign copy is valid and readable.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Create one browser download payload with schema/baseline/checksum/provenance; source is unchanged.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Regeneration is byte-stable for the same snapshot.

workflowCommands.title: Безопасно отключить клиент без удаления персонажа
workflowCommands.guards: GM authority current; selected device/seat exists; safe boundary; no owned pending command; reason present.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Detach device/seat transport once while preserving campaign character, group, inventory and reconnect binding.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same commandId returns the disconnect receipt; later reconnect uses the preserved binding.

workflowCommands.title: Отклонить заявку на длительный отдых
workflowCommands.guards: Request=PENDING; GM authority current; non-empty reason.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Reject one request without changing game time, HP/OE, group membership or any rest progress.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same request decision returns the prior rejection receipt.

workflowCommands.title: Запустить валидный длительный отдых
workflowCommands.guards: Participants/start/watch mode valid; WITH_WATCH has complete minute coverage; no active-scene conflict.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Create one group rest plus required personal segments without advancing world time.
workflowCommands.reconnect: RestId and schedule restore exactly; repeated start does not create a second rest.

workflowCommands.title: Разрешить прерывание длительного отдыха
workflowCommands.guards: Rest=INTERRUPTED; interruption facts persisted; decision=RESUME|CHANGE_FUTURE.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Apply the exact preserve/reset rule once and create at most one new personal segment on RESUME.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Pending interruption remains blocking; receipt prevents a second reset/resume.

workflowCommands.title: Сохранить только будущую часть графика отдыха
workflowCommands.guards: Stop timestamp and reason fixed; past immutable; future coverage valid.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Replace only future watch segments; elapsed world time and past schedule remain byte-stable.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Schedule revision restores; stale revision is rejected before change.

workflowCommands.title: Атомарно создать локальную кампанию
workflowCommands.guards: All CMP-001..004 stages valid; baseline/catalog and host-bind preflight pass; campaignDraftId not committed.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Create exactly one campaignId in PAUSED state, host configuration and creation receipt; zero players is valid.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same commandId returns the same campaignId/receipt and never binds a second host.

workflowCommands.title: Подтвердить серию боевых действий
workflowCommands.guards: Effective controller owns actor; every entry remains in actor-specific availableActions with eligible targets and total cost within budget; every entry declares resolutionKind=ROLL|DETERMINISTIC; ROLL has an immutable mode snapshot and request, DETERMINISTIC has neither.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Create one immutable ordered series. For first resolutionKind=ROLL publish only its AUTO/MANUAL rollRequest; for DETERMINISTIC dispatch directly to CMB-038. After each entry, the next entry follows the same typed branch; no partial reserve, reorder or client-selected route.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Series, per-entry resolutionKind, current index, roll requests/mode snapshots, deterministic receipts and next typed stage restore without duplication or return to the editor.

workflowCommands.title: Открыть, закрыть или завершить player loot session
workflowCommands.guards: Player loot phase active; corpse policy and lock revision current; decision=ACQUIRE|RELEASE|PLAYER_DONE.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Acquire/release one exclusive loot lock or mark one player done; already transferred items are never rolled back.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Lock ownership and done receipt restore; stale corpse revision rejects before change.

workflowCommands.title: Изменить вместимость кампании
workflowCommands.guards: Safe boundary; 1<=newCapacity<=5; newCapacity>=activePlayerCount; current revision.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Persist one capacity value without removing or moving any character.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same commandId returns the prior capacity receipt; stale revision rejects.

workflowCommands.title: Сменить пароль мастера
workflowCommands.guards: Current secret valid; new secret and confirmation match; safe boundary.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Replace the local master secret once; never serialize old/new secret to a player projection or audit payload.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Receipt restores only success metadata, never the secret value.

workflowCommands.title: Поставить кампанию на паузу или возобновить
workflowCommands.guards: Single current host authority; reason present; safe boundary; no pending operation; decision=PAUSE|RESUME.
workflowCommands.atomicity: PAUSE writes checkpoint+status+clock freeze together; RESUME restores the same authoritative checkpoint without duplicate host.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Status/checkpoint receipt restores exactly and conflicting master remains blocked.

workflowCommands.title: Запустить подготовленную кампанию
workflowCommands.guards: At least one valid active PC; every included controlling device Ready; one master authority; campaign PAUSED.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Set campaign HOSTING and create the initial peace scene once; free capacity remains unchanged.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Start receipt restores without a second scene or duplicate authority.

workflowCommands.title: Атомарно начать боевую ситуацию
workflowCommands.guards: Latest preflight passes at the current revision; committed sequential stage receipts exist for IDENTITY, PARTY, OPPOSITION, INSTANCES, PLACEMENT, VISIBILITY and SCENE; A/B/position/visibility valid; no pending request; initiative may still be absent.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Activate combat, deep-pin exactly the checkpointed actor snapshots, freeze world clock and pause selected rest together.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Start receipt restores the same draft-stage receipts, actors, clock and rest state; never starts combat twice or fills a skipped stage implicitly.

workflowCommands.title: Завершить сцену нападения и открыть инициативу
workflowCommands.guards: Ambush phase ACTIVE for the combat created by the committed Start receipt; no pending command/reaction; all required CORE-088/089 choices and command receipts resolved; close receipt absent.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Close the preinitiative phase once, commit one phase-close receipt and only then create initial initiative requests; never count it as round one.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Closed receipt restores the initiative boundary without replaying ambush actions or reopening the phase.

workflowCommands.title: Завершить фазу добычи
workflowCommands.guards: Loot eligibility receipt committed; lootPhaseStatus=ACTIVE; all player sessions done; no active lock or pending loot command; transferred items already committed; close receipt absent.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Set lootPhaseStatus=COMPLETED, commit one loot-phase-close receipt and only then open temporary-actor disposition without rolling back any item transfer.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same command returns the prior close receipt; released locks do not reappear and zero locks alone never implies completion.

workflowCommands.title: Создать ускоренный D20/D12/D6 пакет одной команды
workflowCommands.guards: Current command declared; before first roll; effective controller owns command; no package exists.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Persist one packageId with one D20, D12 and D6 result tied only to that commandId.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Package/results/consumption map restore; reconnect never rerolls or moves a result to another command.

workflowCommands.title: Зафиксировать результат адресуемого rollRequest
workflowCommands.guards: Pending request; correct owner; immutable requestContext and originRollKind match the request; mode snapshot matches form; manual face in range or server auto RNG receipt valid; ORIGINAL_D20 critical/XP eligibility flags are fixed; confirmation/substitution links point to the persisted origin; for a series the request belongs to its immutable currentEntryIndex.
workflowCommands.atomicity: Persist one raw face and origin receipt for one rollRequestId. ORIGINAL may start one critical chain and one deduplicated XP event according to its flags; CRITICAL_CONFIRMATION/SUBSTITUTION never starts either. Domain requestContext remains unchanged and resolution advances only the matching command/series entry.
workflowCommands.reconnect: Same submission returns the prior face and origin linkage; different payload rejects; auto never rerolls; requestContext/originRollKind/currentEntryIndex and the next pending stage restore exactly.

workflowCommands.title: Отменить собственный pending device request
